component.name: DataFetcher
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "run" end sub
sub run() url = m.top.url if url = invalid or Len(url) = 0 m.top.success = false m.top.response = "" return end if tp = CreateObject("roMessagePort") req = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") req.SetMessagePort(tp) req.SetURL(url) req.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") req.InitClientCertificates() req.EnableEncodings(true) req.AddHeader("User-Agent", "HushMusicTV/1.0 Roku")
if req.AsyncGetToString() msg = wait(30000, tp) ' 30s timeout if type(msg) = "roUrlEvent" and msg.GetResponseCode() = 200 m.top.success = true m.top.response = msg.GetString() return end if end if m.top.success = false m.top.response = "" end sub
